charcoal.png.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: empty photographic background for later compositing a genuine small factory product photograph, not a product render. Primary request: ONE entirely EMPTY medium cool-charcoal gray studio field, horizontal near-square ratio around 1.1:1. View: close oblique camera angled down toward a continuous matte paperboard plane, no horizon, no tabletop edge. Very fine close-grained graphite board microtexture, subtle and uniform without obvious pores or rocky mottling. Soft wide studio light upper left and slight natural falloff lower right. Medium dark gray, NOT black, enough separation for a black object which will be composited later. Understated expensive industrial catalogue photography like a quiet professional tabletop shoot. No objects anywhere. No product, metal, lock, keys, screws, fabricated shadows, props, plants, cloth, decorative panels, text, labels, logos or watermarks. No white border, no vignette, no dramatic spotlight. Empty textured field only.
